contracts: Pure flip forwards source allocation, kernel context and opaque DXGI context through the actual callback. Callback HRESULT is preserved.
Reject flags combinations, non-PRESENT/private allocations, destination-bound flips and invalid intervals before calling the runtime.
Readback preserves changing pixels across staging reuse and strips source/upload row padding. Unsupported input does not replace output.
File publication preserves complete prior frame for a concurrently open reader, exposes the new complete frame to a new reader, and rejects malformed pixels before publication.
